supporting_observations.claim: The alerted activity consists of repeated failed network logons for svc-docsync on FILE-MAP-01, with the workstation field identifying FILE-MAP-01 and the source address shown as 10.53.20.20.
The failures recur at roughly one-minute intervals and report an incorrect-password status; corresponding domain-controller records also report status 0xc000006a.

The timing, recurring cadence, account, and host are consistent with the supplied inventory and change-calendar context: svc-docsync runs every minute on FILE-MAP-01 and its password was scheduled for rotation at 13:30 UTC, with a manual job update required. This makes stale job credentials after rotation the most likely explanation for the failures.
Some domain-controller records show Kerberos pre-authentication failures for svc-docsync from 10.53.20.20, also consistent with unsuccessful authentication using an invalid credential.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records show failed authentication attempts but do not establish whether the scheduled password rotation was completed or whether the DocSync job was subsequently updated.
The FILE-MAP-01 failure records name lsass.exe as the process; they do not identify the application or job that supplied the credentials.
The supplied evidence does not establish whether authentication succeeded at another time during the 13:20–14:20 UTC review window.
claims_not_established: That an attacker was attempting to guess or use svc-docsync credentials.
That the password rotation occurred at 13:30 UTC or that the job continued using an old password.
That any successful logon, access, or follow-on activity resulted from these failures.
That the listed records are a complete account of authentication activity throughout the review window.
additional_evidence_needed: If confirmation is needed before closure, verify the password-rotation and DocSync job-update records for 2026-09-22.
unrelated_findings: T162-00035 records a SYSTEM process named Veeam.Backup.Service.exe on DC-MAP-01 using explicit credentials for svc-docsync with PROXY-MAP-01 as the target server. The available record does not establish that authentication or a connection succeeded, or that this event is related to the recurring FILE-MAP-01 failures. Review separately, since the supplied approved-backup context identifies Safeharbor rather than Veeam.
